description: Describe every screen as data instead of a picture: solid rectangles (buttons, cards, panels) and, for text-mode screens, text runs with colours, plus what the program is waiting for. Works for any script. Default format is compact: each rectangle is one string "NAME #colour x,y WxH @cx,cy" where NAME is a label you set with craftos_labels and @cx,cy is the cell to touch. delta:true returns only what changed since the previous craftos_ui / craftos_script view (use it after every action). format:"full" gives the raw objects. Use instead of craftos_screenshot to find and verify things.

delta.description: Return only what changed since the previous call.

name: craftos_ui
